high_level_description: The image features a person wearing a black Oakley t-shirt with the brand's logo prominently displayed on the chest. The individual is also wearing white-framed sunglasses with red-tinted lenses. They have curly hair and are wearing a watch on their left wrist. The person has their arms crossed. In the background, there is a wall with framed artwork. The top frame contains an illustration of a vase with a bird perched on it, set against a beige background. Below that, another frame displays a colorful owl design with vibrant orange and red tones.
